photos.c: Pictured above is Surrey’s sprint relay team which set a record in the Women’s Inter-County Championship.  From left to right they are Jennifer Taylor (Mitcham AC), Marianne Dew (Selsonia LAC), Mary Hall (Hercules AC) and Janet Neil (Mitcham AC).  Of course Marianne Dew is none other than our own Marianne Black. Photo by Gerry Cranham.
